test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "Resources."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• For blank 1, the correct answer is "resources."**
 
• **"Resources"** means a supply of something, a piece of equipment, etc. that is available for somebody to use. (उपयोग के लिए उपलब्‍ध सामग्री; संसाधन)
 
 
• **Example**: *Russia is rich in natural **resources**__ such as oil and minerals.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2. 
 
• Correct passage:

Management like any other art can be learnt and developed. Management means managing all our __**resources**__ - money, material, machines and most importantly, manpower. Since we can maximise ______ (2) ______ only through people they have to be treated well. ______ (3) ______ is the key to man - management. People can be forced to work but they have to be motivated to work well. People can be motivated as much through ______ (4) ______ for doing their best as through timely and brief reprimands for poor performance. In order to maximise production, a manager will have to be ‘tough and nice’, not ‘nice and tough’ because everyone needs not only to be praised but also ______ (5) ______.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Characters: **the qualities that make somebody/something different from other people or things; the nature of somebody/something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति का चरित्र, विशिष्‍ट लक्षण; प्रकृति, स्‍वभाव)
 
• **Activities: **a situation in which there is a lot of action or movement. (सक्रियता, क्रियाशीलता; गतिविधियों से पूर्ण स्थिति)
 
• **Features: **an important or noticeable part of something. ((किसी का) महत्वपूर्ण या उल्‍लेखनीय भाग)

180:Tf6b,

The correct answer is "productivity."
